The real issue is missing bounds checking or return statements in case 3, but this patch introduces illogical code that weakens functionality and doesn't generalize to the actual bug.

This is overfitting to pass the test without understanding the root cause—the real issue is missing bounds checks before charAt() calls in cases 3 and 4.
